_doc: Growth (XP) rules of the battle plan, area 'Fortschritt, XP und Training' (docs/KAMPF_PLAN_1000.md). Read by scripts/core/GrowthRules.gd. difficulty_mult: per difficulty (Story, Tamer, Veteran, Rift-Born). rematch_mult: a Wayfarer's or Warden's rematch. kinship_min / kinship_mult: a Spirling this fond of the Wayfarer learns faster (Era II on, Kinship). world_goal_*: after the world goal of the week reaches 100 %, the next battles give more growth. no_grind_battles: balance goal, the most even wild battles one Spirling needs from one Warden ring cap to the next against foes of the median yield (Tamer). battle_spark_chance: after a won world battle, each fighter has this chance per fallen foe to raise its spark in the foe's strongest value by 1 (GrowthRules.battle_spark; no sparks from duels or the training ring). tower_items: the first clear of every fifth tower floor gives the next of these (RiftTower.finish). There is no top ring; caps only hold on Veteran and Rift-Born in Act I.
